sections.subtitle: Priča zbog koje podcast uopće postoji
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec govori kako bi o njegovoj i Kruninoj zajedničkoj priči trebalo snimiti dokumentarac
sections.content:
Voditelj Kruno započinje temu koja je, prema vlastitom priznanju, ključna za cijeli razgovor. Nakon rasprave o podjelama među katolicima zaključuje da u tome često sudjeluje i velik ego kojemu tu nije mjesto. Ističe da bi upravo u **pro-life pokretu** svi trebali biti jednodušni, jer je cilj spasiti što više nerođenih života, ali i živote roditelja i što više duša.

Zatim gosta pita što ga je dovelo u borbu za život. Pritom priznaje da odgovor već dobro zna, ali želi da ga čuju i drugi. Kruno otvoreno kaže da je ta priča razlog zbog kojeg obojica danas sjede u studiju. Po njegovim riječima, ni njega ne bi bilo u ovom podcastu da se Ivanovoj obitelji nije dogodilo ono što se dogodilo.

Ivan Pokupec potvrđuje da je riječ o njihovoj zajedničkoj priči i dodaje da bi o njoj jednog dana trebalo snimiti dobar dokumentarac. Kaže da ni danas ne može pojmiti na koje je sve čudesne načine Bog tu djelovao. Za Boga u svom životu koristi slikovitu usporedbu: on je netko tko **malog Muju primi za kragnu i stavi na pravo mjesto u pravo vrijeme**.

Ivan objašnjava da je kao vjernik uvijek bio načelno protiv pobačaja. No naglašava da sve dobiva sasvim drugu dimenziju kada pobačaj uđe u život vlastite obitelji.
sections.subtitle_en: The story why the podcast exists in the first place
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec speaks about how a documentary should be made about his and Kruno's shared story
sections.content_en:
The host Kruno begins the topic that is, by his own admission, crucial for the entire conversation. After a discussion about divisions among Catholics, he concludes that a big ego often takes part in this, which has no place there. He emphasizes that precisely in the **pro-life movement** everyone should be of one mind, because the goal is to save as many unborn lives as possible, but also the lives of parents and as many souls as possible.

Then he asks the guest what brought him into the fight for life. In doing so, he admits that he already knows the answer well, but wants others to hear it too. Kruno openly says that this story is the reason why both of them are sitting in the studio today. According to his words, he himself would not be in this podcast either if what happened had not happened to Ivan's family.

Ivan Pokupec confirms that it is about their shared story and adds that one day a good documentary should be made about it. He says that even today he cannot comprehend all the miraculous ways God acted there. For God in his life, he uses a vivid comparison: He is someone who **takes little Mujo by the collar and puts him in the right place at the right time**.

Ivan explains that as a believer he was always in principle against abortion. But he emphasizes that everything takes on a completely different dimension when abortion enters the life of one's own family.

sections.subtitle: Ultimatum: pobačaj ili se ne vraćaj kući
sections.screenshot_description: Gost opisuje ultimatum koji je obitelj trudne djevojke postavila svojoj kćeri
sections.content:
Ivan Pokupec u najkraćim crtama opisuje događaj koji mu je promijenio život. Njegov mlađi brat, gotovo punih deset godina mlađi od njega, postao je otac: njegova djevojka ostala je trudna. Oboje su tada bili mladi srednjoškolci.

Djevojčina obitelj inzistirala je na pobačaju iz, kako Ivan kaže, onih klasičnih razloga: da dijete ne uništi njezin život i da joj ne oduzme prilike. Kruno tome dodaje i pitanje „što će ljudi reći“. Na njegov upit Ivan potvrđuje da je djevojka bila maloljetna, imala je 17 i pol godina kada je zatrudnjela.

Ivan posebno naglašava jedan paradoks. Djevojčina obitelj, koja bi se i tada nazvala vjerničkom, postavila je ultimatum: **ili ćeš ići na pobačaj ili se ne vraćaj kući**. Najgore je, kaže, što su taj ultimatum na kraju i ispunili.

### Poziv „luđaku na najpozitivniji mogući način“

Ivan priznaje da je bio izgubljen i nije znao što napraviti ni kome se obratiti. Tada se sjetio **Ante Čaljkušića**, kojeg je poznavao s fakulteta i o kojem je čuo iz medija. S dozom humora ga opisuje kao „luđaka na najpozitivniji mogući način“ i dodaje da svatko tko ga poznaje zna koliko je specifičan. Kako se nije imao kome drugome okrenuti, pronašao je njegov kontakt s jednostavnom molbom: „Ante, pomozi.“

Od tog trenutka priča se, kako kaže, „razvezala“. Velikogorička ekipa inicijative **40 dana za život**, ljudi potpuno nepoznati njegovoj obitelji, ne samo da se uključila u slučaj, nego je bila spremna učiniti sve što je potrebno da se dijete spasi. Ivan se borbi pridružio zajedno s njima.
sections.subtitle_en: Ultimatum: abortion or do not come back home
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest describes the ultimatum that the pregnant girl's family gave to their daughter
sections.content_en:
Ivan Pokupec briefly describes the event that changed his life. His younger brother, almost a full ten years younger than him, became a father: his girlfriend became pregnant. Both were young high school students at the time.

The girl's family insisted on an abortion for, as Ivan says, those classic reasons: so that the child would not ruin her life and take away her opportunities. Kruno adds to this the question of "what will people say". To his inquiry, Ivan confirms that the girl was a minor, she was 17 and a half years old when she became pregnant.

Ivan especially emphasizes one paradox. The girl's family, who even then would have called themselves believers, issued an ultimatum: **either you go have an abortion or do not come back home**. The worst thing, he says, is that in the end they actually fulfilled that ultimatum.

### A call to a "madman in the most positive possible way"

Ivan admits that he was lost and did not know what to do or whom to turn to. That was when he remembered **Ante Čaljkušić**, whom he knew from university and had heard about in the media. With a dose of humor, he describes him as a "madman in the most positive possible way" and adds that anyone who knows him knows how specific he is. Since he had no one else to turn to, he found his contact with a simple plea: "Ante, help."

From that moment on, the story, as he says, "unraveled". The Velika Gorica team of the initiative **40 dana za život**, people completely unknown to his family, not only got involved in the case, but were ready to do everything necessary to save the child. Ivan joined the fight alongside them.

sections.subtitle: Julijan, hodajući blagoslov
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec s emocijom opisuje nećaka Julijana kao hodajući blagoslov
sections.content:
Priča ima sretan kraj. **Julijan** je rođen 8. prosinca 2016. godine. Danas je školarac, a Ivan ga opisuje kao predivno dijete i „predivnog dječačića“.

Prema Ivanovim riječima, Julijan je donio velike blagoslove ne samo u život njegova brata i bratove supruge, nego i cijele obitelji. Kad bi se netko dao na posao, kaže, trebalo bi ispisati dobar A4 list papira o svemu što je to dijete promijenilo u njihovim životima. Zaključuje kratko: **Julijan je i danas hodajući blagoslov.**
sections.subtitle_en: Julijan, a walking blessing
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec emotionally describes his nephew Julijan as a walking blessing
sections.content_en:
The story has a happy ending. **Julijan** was born on December 8, 2016. Today he is a schoolboy, and Ivan describes him as a wonderful child and a "wonderful little boy".

According to Ivan's words, Julijan brought great blessings not only into the life of his brother and his brother's wife, but also of the whole family. If someone were to get down to work, he says, one would have to fill a good A4 sheet of paper about everything that this child changed in their lives. He concludes briefly: **Julijan is a walking blessing to this day.**

sections.subtitle: Od zahvalnosti do inicijative u Križevcima
sections.screenshot_description: Gost objašnjava kako je odlučio pokrenuti inicijativu 40 dana za život u Križevcima
sections.content:
Ivan Pokupec kaže da ga je ta borba mnogo naučila. Izbliza je vidio na koje se sve načine zlo urotilo da ubije to dijete i da „otrgne taj život“. Nakon toga osjetio se pozvanim uzvratiti inicijativi koja mu je pomogla.

U to su vrijeme imali neslužbenu informaciju da se u **Domu zdravlja u Križevcima** nelegalno izvode pobačaji. Ivan je zaključio da inicijativi može najbolje uzvratiti tako da je proširi, pa je pokrenuta i u Križevcima.

Uslijedio je, kako kaže, novi blagoslov: uključio se i Kruno, koji je, u Ivanovim riječima, „to preuzeo onako muški“. Prema njihovim saznanjima, **pobačaji u Križevcima potom su potpuno zaustavljeni**.

Ivan nabraja kako im je sve „stostruko vraćeno“:
- inicijativa se dodatno proširila,
- Julijan danas ima mlađeg brata,
- životi njegova mlađeg brata i bratove supruge, koji su prije „išli nigdje“, sada imaju smisao i cilj.

Iz svega toga, zaključuje Ivan, proizašlo je i njegovo poslanje: blagoslov koji je dobila njegova obitelj proširiti na što više strana.
sections.subtitle_en: From Gratitude to the Initiative in Križevci
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest explains how he decided to launch the 40 dana za život initiative in Križevci
sections.content_en:
Ivan Pokupec says that this struggle taught him a lot. Up close, he saw all the ways evil conspired to kill that child and to "tear that life away". After that, he felt called to give back to the initiative that had helped him.

At that time, they had unofficial information that abortions were being performed illegally at the **Dom zdravlja in Križevci**. Ivan concluded that he could best give back to the initiative by expanding it, so it was launched in Križevci as well.

There followed, as he says, a new blessing: Kruno also joined, who, in Ivan's words, "took that on like a man". According to their findings, **abortions in Križevci were then completely stopped**.

Ivan lists how everything was "returned to them a hundredfold":
- the initiative expanded further,
- Julijan today has a younger brother,
- the lives of his younger brother and his brother's wife, which previously "went nowhere", now have meaning and a goal.

From all of this, Ivan concludes, his mission also emerged: to spread the blessing that his family received to as many sides as possible.

sections.subtitle: Kruno: dječak kojeg nikad nisam upoznao promijenio mi je život
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Kruno priča kako ga je Julijanova priča uvela u pro-life i apostolat za muškarce
sections.content:
Kruno smatra da Ivanova priča savršeno pokazuje vrijednost jednog nerođenog života. Takav život, kaže, može promijeniti sudbinu ne samo jedne obitelji nego i mnogih drugih ljudi.

Voditelj zatim opisuje lanac događaja u vlastitom životu. Julijan je potaknuo Ivana da pokrene inicijativu u Križevcima. Ta je inicijativa Kruno uvela u pro-life, a pro-life ga je doveo do **apostolata za muškarce**. Uvidio je, naime, da se pobačaj većinom događa zbog **krize muževnosti**.

Kruno priznaje da Julijana nikada nije upoznao, iako je bio u njegovim molitvama, ali da mu je taj dječak promijenio život. Dok je slušao Ivana o borbi za njegova nećaka, zapitao se što bi bilo da se to dogodi njegovu nećaku i da se za njegov život vodi isti duhovni rat. Kaže da je u Ivanovu nećaku prepoznao vlastitog.

Iz toga izvodi pouku: važno je da svi osvijeste kako su nerođeni životi njihova obitelj, njihova braća i sestre.
sections.subtitle_en: Kruno: the boy I never met changed my life
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Kruno talks about how Julijan's story introduced him to pro-life and the apostolate for men
sections.content_en:
Kruno believes that Ivan's story perfectly demonstrates the value of an unborn life. Such a life, he says, can change the destiny not only of one family, but also of many other people.

The host then describes a chain of events in his own life. Julijan prompted Ivan to start an initiative in Križevci. That initiative introduced Kruno to pro-life, and pro-life led him to the **apostolate for men**. He realized, namely, that abortion mostly happens because of a **crisis of masculinity**.

Kruno admits that he never met Julijan, although he was in his prayers, but that this boy changed his life. While listening to Ivan speak about the struggle for his nephew, he wondered what would happen if that were to happen to his nephew and if the same spiritual warfare were fought for his life. He says that in Ivan's nephew he recognized his own.

From this he draws a lesson: it is important that everyone becomes aware that unborn lives are their family, their brothers and sisters.

sections.subtitle: „Gdje ti je brat?“ i pitanje koje je promijenilo Ivanov stav
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec prepričava trenutak kada ga je Kruno pitao može li ubojstvo biti legalno
sections.content:
Kruno svoj angažman povezuje s biblijskim pitanjem s prvih stranica Svetog pisma: **„Gdje ti je brat?“** Kaže da mu upravo ta rečenica uvijek dolazi na um kada razmišlja hoće li otići na bdijenje ispred doma zdravlja ili bolnice. Netko se možda baš tada bori za život, objašnjava, i potrebno je da ondje stoji, svjedoči i mirno moli. Njegova prisutnost može nekoga odvratiti od pobačaja i spasiti nerođeno dijete.

Ivan Pokupec dodaje da se blagoslov koji je preko Julijana stigao do Krune vratio i njemu. Živo se sjeća svojih tadašnjih dvojbi. Što se tiče pobačaja u vlastitom životu, obitelji i užoj okolini, sve mu je bilo jasno. No smatrao je da bi možda bilo licemjerno određivati drugima, jer je „svačija situacija drugačija“.

Tada mu je Kruno postavio jednostavno pitanje: **može li ubojstvo biti legalno?** Ivan priznaje da je zastao i zapitao se vjeruje li doista da je pobačaj ubojstvo. Zaključio je da nesumnjivo jest, a ako je ubojstvo, onda nikako ne može biti legalan.

Ivan svjestan je da će druga strana reći kako je postao radikalniji nego prije. On sam smatra da je sada **razumniji**, jer mu je jasan širi kontekst pobačaja. Zaključuje da su on i Kruno u cijeloj priči „poslužili jedan drugome“.

Kruno priznaje da se tog svog komentara iskreno ne sjeća. Vidi ga kao Boga na djelu i jednu njegovu veliku providnost.
sections.subtitle_en: „Where is your brother?“ and the question that changed Ivan's stance
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec recounts the moment when Kruno asked him whether murder could be legal
sections.content_en:
Kruno connects his involvement with the biblical question from the first pages of Sacred Scripture: **„Where is your brother?“** He says that that very sentence always comes to his mind when he considers whether to go to a vigil in front of a health center or hospital. Someone might be fighting for life at that very moment, he explains, and it is necessary for him to stand there, witness, and pray peacefully. His presence can deter someone from abortion and save an unborn child.

Ivan Pokupec adds that the blessing that reached Kruno through Julijan returned to him as well. He vividly remembers his doubts at that time. As far as abortion in his own life, family, and immediate circle was concerned, everything was clear to him. But he thought that it might be hypocritical to dictate to others, because „everyone's situation is different“.

Then Kruno asked him a simple question: **can murder be legal?** Ivan admits that he paused and asked himself whether he truly believed that abortion is murder. He concluded that it undoubtedly is, and if it is murder, then it can in no way be legal.

Ivan is aware that the other side will say that he has become more radical than before. He himself considers that he is now **more reasonable**, because the broader context of abortion is clear to him. He concludes that in the whole story, he and Kruno „served one another“.

Kruno admits that he honestly does not remember that comment of his. He sees it as God at work and a great providence of His.

sections.subtitle: Šimun: 30 posto šanse i šest operacija
sections.screenshot_description: Gost opisuje tešku malformaciju ošita s kojom je rođen njegov sin Šimun
sections.content:
Kruno primjećuje da se u ovoj i drugim Ivanovim pričama osjeća „Božji prst“. Budući da se epizoda bliži kraju, pita ga o sinu i o projektu koji je nastao nakon sinove bolesti, a danas pomaže mnogima.

Ivan Pokupec priča o mlađem sinu **Šimunu**, rođenom krajem 2015. godine s teškom malformacijom unutarnjih organa. Šimunov se **ošit nije do kraja zatvorio** prije rođenja. Budući da je beba u maternici okrenuta naopačke, organi trbušne šupljine prešli su u prsnu šupljinu i, kako Ivan kaže, „svi su se organi pomiješali“.

Šimun je fizički bio velika beba, težak 4600 grama i dug pedesetak centimetara. U sebi je ipak nosio jedan od najtežih poremećaja. Roditeljima su rekli da je to stanje do 2006. bilo neoperabilno i značilo sigurnu smrtnu presudu.

### Pobačaj kao prva ponuđena opcija

Dijagnozu su doznali već na ultrazvuku, a prvo što im je predloženo bio je **pobačaj**. Ivan to izdvaja kao zanimljivu epizodu: po njegovu iskustvu, ginekolozi danas često nude pobačaj kao jednu od opcija.

Šimunu su dali **30 posto šanse za preživljavanje**. Rodio se, a zatim je slijedila prva operacija, pa druga, treća, sve do šeste. Danas je desetogodišnjak koji zna sve o dinosaurima, gušterima i žabama i kod kuće izrađuje terarije. Ivan ga s ponosom naziva „zjenicom tatinog oka“.
sections.subtitle_en: Šimun: A 30 Percent Chance and Six Surgeries
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest describes the severe diaphragmatic malformation with which his son Šimun was born
sections.content_en:
Kruno notes that in this and other of Ivan's stories, „the finger of God“ can be felt. Since the episode is nearing its end, he asks him about his son and about the project that was created after his son's illness, which today helps many.

Ivan Pokupec talks about his younger son **Šimun**, born at the end of 2015 with a severe malformation of internal organs. Šimun's **diaphragm did not fully close** before birth. Since the baby in the womb is turned upside down, the organs of the abdominal cavity moved into the chest cavity and, as Ivan says, „all the organs got mixed up“.

Šimun was physically a large baby, weighing 4600 grams and about fifty centimeters long. Yet inside he carried one of the most severe disorders. The parents were told that until 2006 this condition was inoperable and meant a certain death sentence.

### Abortion as the First Offered Option

They found out the diagnosis already on the ultrasound, and the first thing suggested to them was **abortion**. Ivan highlights this as an interesting episode: in his experience, gynecologists today often offer abortion as one of the options.

They gave Šimun a **30 percent chance of survival**. He was born, and then followed the first surgery, then the second, third, all the way to the sixth. Today he is a ten-year-old who knows everything about dinosaurs, lizards, and frogs and makes terrariums at home. Ivan proudly calls him „the pupil of daddy's eye“.

sections.subtitle: Od „kućne kreme“ do obiteljskog posla Astopic
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec opisuje kako je supruga farmaceutkinja napravila kremu za sina
sections.content:
Uz sve teške dijagnoze, Šimun je dobio i **atopijski dermatitis**. Ivan priznaje da se nakon životno opasnih operacija atopijski dermatitis činio manjim problemom. Ipak, obitelj se s njim godinama borila bez uspjeha.

Preokret je donijela njegova supruga, **magistra farmacije** po struci. Kad je vidjela da konvencionalni pristup ne donosi rješenje, odlučila je nešto poduzeti sama. Kod kuće je napravila **kremu bez kortikosteroida**, koju su tada zvali jednostavno „kućna krema“, i ona je Šimunu pomagala.

Priča se zatim, kako Ivan kaže, Božjom providnošću i gotovo polusvjesno počela širiti. Kremu su tražili prijatelji, pa prijatelji prijatelja, pa njihovi prijatelji. Ivan se vraća na misao s početka razgovora da mu treba dugo da sazrije u nekim stvarima. Tek nakon nekoliko godina sinulo mu je: ako krema pomaže svim tim ljudima, zašto je ne bi učinili široko dostupnom?

Tako je nastao **Astopic**. Ivan ga opisuje kao hrvatski proizvod nastao iz ljubavi jedne majke prema djetetu. Uskoro slavi prvu godišnjicu, a prema Ivanovim riječima već je srušio mnoge rekorde hrvatske kozmetičke industrije:
- polako kreće u izvoz,
- ima ogroman broj kupaca,
- skupio je stotine pozitivnih recenzija,
- bilježi konstantan rast, iako je tek na početku.

Ivan zaključuje da je Bog iz jedne nevolje i velikog problema stvorio nešto nemjerljivo blagoslovljeno, a to je postalo uspješan obiteljski posao.
sections.subtitle_en: From "homemade cream" to the family business Astopic
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec describes how his pharmacist wife made a cream for their son
sections.content_en:
Alongside all the difficult diagnoses, Šimun also developed **atopic dermatitis**. Ivan admits that after life-threatening surgeries, atopic dermatitis seemed like a minor problem. Nevertheless, the family struggled with it for years without success.

The turning point was brought by his wife, a **Master of Pharmacy** by profession. When she saw that the conventional approach offered no solution, she decided to take action herself. At home, she made a **corticosteroid-free cream**, which they simply called "homemade cream" at the time, and it helped Šimun.

The story then, as Ivan says, by God's providence and almost semi-consciously, began to spread. Friends asked for the cream, then friends of friends, then their friends. Ivan returns to the thought from the beginning of the conversation that it takes him a long time to mature in some matters. Only after several years did it dawn on him: if the cream helps all those people, why wouldn't they make it widely available?

That is how **Astopic** was created. Ivan describes it as a Croatian product born out of a mother's love for her child. It is soon celebrating its first anniversary, and according to Ivan's words, it has already broken many records of the Croatian cosmetic industry:
- it is slowly starting export,
- it has a huge number of customers,
- it has gathered hundreds of positive reviews,
- it records constant growth, although it is only at the beginning.

Ivan concludes that from one misfortune and great problem, God created something immeasurably blessed, which has become a successful family business.

sections.subtitle: Bog od smeća naših života radi remek-djelo
sections.screenshot_description: Gost, vidno dirnut, citira Richa Mullinsa o Bogu koji od smeća naših života stvara remek-djelo
sections.content:
Ivan Pokupec se u tom kontekstu uvijek sjeti riječi **Richa Mullinsa**, američkog autora duhovne glazbe. Prepričava snimku s YouTubea na kojoj Mullins prije jedne pjesme govori o svojoj mladosti. Kao melankoličnom tinejdžeru sklonom poeziji i tinejdžerskoj depresiji, stalno su mu govorili: „Ne brini, Bog te voli.“ On bi odgovarao da to samo znači da Bog nema ukusa, jer Bog voli sve, pa po čemu je onda on poseban. Kasnije je, kaže, shvatio što Bog radi: **„Bog uzima smeće naših života i od toga radi remek-djelo.“**

Ivan priznaje da se ježi dok to govori. Kaže da je Bog po tko zna koji put uzeo „smeće“ njihovih života: bolest, nemoć i beznađe.

Zatim opisuje osjećaj koji ne bi poželio nijednom roditelju. To je spoznaja da, koliko god novca, položaja ili moći imao, ne možeš pomoći vlastitom djetetu i možeš ga samo predati Bogu u ruke. Ivan je to proživio. Iz takvog beznađa, ljutnje, bijesa i ogorčenosti Bog je, kaže, izveo nešto što danas pomaže tisućama djece u Hrvatskoj.

Podsjeća na poznatu pjesmicu „Naš Bog je velik“ i dodaje da ljudi nemaju pojma koliko je velik. Zato je, prema njemu, potrebno svjedočanstvo: da ljudi vide koliko je Bog velik u njegovu životu i koliko još veći može biti u njihovu. Zaključuje porukom nade: **ne postoji bolest, ovisnost, prepreka, jad ni bijeda koju Otac ne može izvesti na dobro.**
sections.subtitle_en: God makes a masterpiece out of the garbage of our lives
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest, visibly moved, quotes Rich Mullins about God who creates a masterpiece out of the garbage of our lives
sections.content_en:
In that context, Ivan Pokupec always remembers the words of **Rich Mullins**, the American author of spiritual music. He recounts a recording from YouTube in which Mullins speaks about his youth before one song. As a melancholic teenager prone to poetry and teenage depression, they constantly told him: „Do not worry, God loves you.“ He would reply that that only means God has no taste, because God loves everything, so in what way is he special then. Later, he says, he realized what God does: **„God takes the garbage of our lives and makes a masterpiece out of it.“**

Ivan admits that he gets goosebumps while saying this. He says that God, for who knows which time, took the „garbage“ of their lives: illness, helplessness, and hopelessness.

Then he describes a feeling he would not wish upon any parent. That is the realization that, no matter how much money, position, or power you have, you cannot help your own child and can only surrender them into God's hands. Ivan lived through that. Out of such hopelessness, anger, rage, and bitterness, God, he says, brought out something that today helps thousands of children in Croatia.

He recalls the well-known song „Our God Is Great“ and adds that people have no idea how great He is. That is why, according to him, a testimony is needed: so that people see how great God is in his life and how even greater He can be in theirs. He concludes with a message of hope: **there is no illness, addiction, obstacle, misery, or distress that the Father cannot turn to good.**

sections.subtitle: Blic pitanja: vjera u praksi, znak jednakosti i Ivan Krstitelj
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec se smije dok odgovara na provokativna ili-ili pitanja
sections.content:
Kruno ocjenjuje Ivanove misli kao prekrasne za kraj epizode, ali prije odjave postavlja nekoliko „ili-ili“ pitanja. Najavljuje da su pomalo provokativna, jer dobro zna kako gost razmišlja.

- **Teologija ili vjera u praksi?** Ivan bez zadrške odgovara: „Vjera u praksi. Točka. Nema dileme.“
- **SDP ili HDZ?** Kruno najavljuje da će ga ovo pitanje nasmijati. Ivan prvo pita mora li birati, a zatim kaže da bi između njih stavio „znak jednakosti, manje-više“. Kruno to proglašava najboljim odgovorom.
- **Sveti Petar ili sveti Pavao?** Nakon kratkog oklijevanja Ivan bira Pavla, „po svom karakteru“. Kruno priznaje da je to i očekivao.
- **Ivan Pernar ili Ivan Sinčić?** Ivan izbjegava izbor i odgovara: „Ivan Krstitelj.“ Kruno to naziva odličnim izborom.
- **Prisutnost u javnosti ili u obitelji?** Ivan bira obitelj, uz napomenu da se to nužno mora prelijevati i na javnost.
- **Osobno poduzetništvo ili sigurnost stalnog posla?** Ivan tvrdi da sigurnost stalnog posla danas ne postoji i bira poduzetništvo za svakoga tko ima „malo grifa“ za to. Kruno zaključuje da je to najbolje pokazao Ivanov vlastiti primjer.
sections.subtitle_en: Quickfire questions: faith in practice, equals sign, and John the Baptist
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec laughs while answering provocative either-or questions
sections.content_en:
Kruno evaluates Ivan's thoughts as wonderful for the end of the episode, but before signing off, he asks a few "either-or" questions. He announces that they are somewhat provocative, because he knows well how the guest thinks.

- **Theology or faith in practice?** Ivan answers without hesitation: "Faith in practice. Period. There is no dilemma."
- **SDP or HDZ?** Kruno announces that this question will make him laugh. Ivan first asks if he has to choose, and then says that he would put "an equals sign, more or less" between them. Kruno declares that the best answer.
- **Saint Peter or Saint Paul?** After a brief hesitation, Ivan chooses Paul, "according to my character." Kruno admits that he expected that.
- **Ivan Pernar or Ivan Sinčić?** Ivan avoids the choice and answers: "John the Baptist." Kruno calls that an excellent choice.
- **Presence in the public or in the family?** Ivan chooses family, with the note that this must necessarily spill over into the public as well.
- **Personal entrepreneurship or the security of a permanent job?** Ivan claims that the security of a permanent job does not exist today and chooses entrepreneurship for anyone who has "a bit of a knack" for it. Kruno concludes that Ivan's own example showed that best.

sections.subtitle: „Muževni budite“: odjava i najava sljedeće epizode
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec zahvaljuje voditelju i poručuje „muževni budite“
sections.content:
Kruno zahvaljuje gostu na vremenu. Kaže da je razgovor lijepo tekao i da su pokrili sve što je smatrao važnim, s obzirom na to da se jako dobro poznaju. Za kraj pita gdje se Ivan vidi za deset godina.

Ivan odgovara da se vidi **u Božjoj milosti**, kao i dosad. Vraća se slici s početka priče: i dalje planira biti voljeni sin i „Mujo“ kojeg će Bog uvijek primiti za kragnu i staviti na pravo mjesto u pravo vrijeme. To mu je, kaže, sve što u životu treba, a sve drugo može otići.

Kruno se veseli Ivanovim budućim „avanturama“ i najavljuje da će u tome blisko surađivati. Ivan uzvraća da je veliki blagoslov imati suborca poput njega i oprašta se porukom koja nosi ime emisije: **„Muževni budite.“**

Kruno to naziva najboljom porukom za kraj. Zahvaljuje gledateljima na praćenju druge epizode i poziva ih da lajkaju, dijele i pretplate se na kanal te da emisiju prate na **Patreonu**, gdje se epizode mogu pogledati i prije redovnog emitiranja. Odjavljuje se riječima „Vidimo se u sljedećoj Redefiniciji“, a Ivan pozdravlja publiku i zahvaljuje ekipi iza kamere.

### Isječak iz sljedeće epizode

Na samom kraju prikazan je kratak isječak sugovornika iz sljedeće epizode. On preporučuje knjigu **„Sanjajte i snovi će nadići realnost“**, koju je napisao prijatelj **svetog Josemaríje Escrive**. Objašnjava da knjiga opisuje istinite događaje, odnosno poticaje koje je Escrivá imao prije osnivanja **Opusa Dei**, Djela Božjega. Ono što je počelo kao ideja tijekom jednog razmatranja danas je, kaže sugovornik, velika struktura u Crkvi i „jedna dobra kičma muževnosti u Crkvi“.
sections.subtitle_en: „Be masculine“: sign-off and announcement of the next episode
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec thanks the host and says „be masculine“
sections.content_en:
Kruno thanks the guest for his time. He says that the conversation flowed nicely and that they covered everything he considered important, given that they know each other very well. In conclusion, he asks where Ivan sees himself in ten years.

Ivan replies that he sees himself **in God's grace**, as until now. He returns to the image from the beginning of the story: he still plans to be a beloved son and a „Mujo“ whom God will always grab by the collar and put in the right place at the right time. That is, he says, all he needs in life, and everything else can go.

Kruno looks forward to Ivan's future „adventures“ and announces that they will collaborate closely on that. Ivan responds that it is a great blessing to have a comrade-in-arms like him and says goodbye with the message that bears the name of the show: **„Be masculine.“**

Kruno calls that the best message for the end. He thanks the viewers for following the second episode and invites them to like, share, and subscribe to the channel, and to follow the show on **Patreon**, where episodes can also be watched before the regular broadcast. He signs off with the words „See you in the next Redefinicija“, and Ivan greets the audience and thanks the crew behind the camera.

### Clip from the next episode

At the very end, a short clip of the interlocutor from the next episode is shown. He recommends the book **„Dream and Dreams Will Exceed Reality“**, written by a friend of **Saint Josemaría Escrivá**. He explains that the book describes true events, that is, the promptings that Escrivá had before founding **Opus Dei**, the Work of God. What began as an idea during one meditation is today, says the interlocutor, a great structure in the Church and „a good backbone of masculinity in the Church“.
